newsitem.title: INDIA: India raises customs duty on colour TV tubes - UNI.
newsitem.headline: India raises customs duty on colour TV tubes - UNI.

text.p: The Indian government has raised the customs duty on colour picture tubes to 35 percent from 30 percent, United News of India (UNI) said on Wednesday.
Earlier Finance Minister P. Chidambaram had proposed a cut in customs duty to 30 percent from 40 percent when presenting the government's 1996/97 (April-March) budget to parliament in July.

The news agency said the government had also decided to reduce the excise duty on paper made out of non-conventional raw materials to five percent from 10 percent, and to exempt anti-cancer drugs from customs duty.
